text:
nora: Heads up — kernel prefetch milestone (M3) might slip. PR #4523 is blocked by two things: infra quota on the CI project and a perf regression in the 4k-seq stress that shows ~8% token throughput drop. Can owners confirm root cause and next steps?

alex: I reproduced locally, failing during warmup. Quick log snippet:```
[FAIL] warmup_eviction_test: OOM at 0x7ff...
command: ./bench --seq 4096 --threads=8
```Seems related to the recent KV prefetch eviction heuristic.

jin: fyi my change to eviction windows might be increasing memory churn under long sequences. Will capture allocation trace.

tara: batching side has a small coupling: the microkernel rebase changed prefetch timing. If eviction is more aggressive we get more cache thrash + smaller batches.

sam: cc @maria infra — CI project quota is hitting GPU mem allocations for canaries, that's why the canary run failed in CI. Temporary workaround could be toggling PREFETCH_SIZE=512 or reducing canary batch size.

maria: I can bump the quota for the dedicated-ci project for today, open ticket #987 with the project id and I'll apply.

deploy-bot: perf-canary: FAILED — regression detected (8.2% throughput drop on 4k-seq). See: https://perf.redwood/profiles/1805552468-canary

nora: Proposed immediate actions: A) revert the eviction tweak (fast) B) apply infra quota bump so CI can re-run canaries C) run local bisect+flamegraph to confirm the culprit D) annotate perf dashboard and create follow-up to fix the eviction heuristic. Who picks what?

alex: I'll prepare a revert PR and link it to #4523. I'll also run a local bisect this afternoon.

tara: I'll coordinate with microkernel owners and test a smaller batch size in the canary config. Putting a quick patch on my branch.

jin: I'll capture a flamegraph tomorrow morning and try a small patch to avoid peak allocations during warmup.

sam: I'll take the perf dashboard annotation and add the regression note + link to the canary trace. If nobody objects, I'll schedule a re-run once quota is bumped.

maria: opened ticket #987 and increased quota for dedicated-ci for 4 hours. Please re-trigger the canary when ready.

nora: Great — assign: alex (revert + bisect), jin (flamegraph + patch), maria (quota bump), tara (canary batch config + coord), sam (dashboard + re-run). We'll aim for a short status update by EOD PT. If anything blocks, ping here or escalate to eng-sre. :thumbsup:
